title: donhobo Men's Rain Jacket — Softshell with Detachable Hood, Green
short_description: Men's outdoor jacket by donhobo in green: softshell made of 100% polyester with a detachable, adjustable hood and several zipped pockets.
long_description: The donhobo men's rain jacket is an outdoor softshell jacket made of 100% polyester. According to Amazon it is lightweight, waterproof, windproof, abrasion-resistant, breathable and quick-drying. The hood is detachable and adjustable, and a fastener is hidden in the collar. There are several zipped pockets: two side pockets, one chest pocket and two inner pockets, including one with a fastener for a passport, wallet or phone. Adjustable cuffs and a drawstring hem help adapt the jacket to wind and weather. According to Amazon it suits hiking, camping, travel and other outdoor activities. Before buying, please check sizes, colours and care instructions on the Amazon product page.
features: Several zipped pockets (side, chest and inner pockets)
buying_angle: Handy for anyone looking for a lightweight men's jacket with a detachable hood and plenty of pockets for hiking, camping and travel, who wants to check size and colour on Amazon before buying.
